components.name: Create a room
components.description: Create a room button with a bordered, pressed bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:3.5rem;padding:0 1.25rem;border:2px solid oklch(0.54 0.17 142);border-bottom:4px solid oklch(0.42 0.14 145);border-radius:.875rem;background:oklch(0.54 0.17 142);color:#fff;font-family:Rubik,ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-bottom-width 120ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)} .ds-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.05)} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid oklch(0.55 0.15 240);outline-offset:3px} .ds-btn:active{transform:translateY(2px);border-bottom-width:2px}

narrative.overview: A clean white game UI for all ages: one confident green action per screen, bordered controls that press down, and a pug host standing right on the page. Encouraging, bold and legible, tactile; it rejects childish pastels, neon arcade looks and cutesy clutter.
keyCharacteristics: One Leaf-green primary action per screen
Rubik over Nunito at heavy weights
Pug cut out directly on the page

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Leaf is the one go-signal; one primary action per screen.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Sun, Bow, Sky and Fawn appear only when they carry meaning.

rules.name: The Pressed-Edge Rule
rules.body: The 4px bottom edge is the one depth device, implemented as border-bottom.

dos: Do keep one primary Leaf action per screen
Do keep every spoken clue visible as text
donts: Don't use pastel tints or bubbly fonts that read as a kids app
